scripts.build: npx rimraf dist&&npm run build:ts&&npm run build:dts
scripts.build:dts: npx copyfiles -u 2 src/@types/*.d.ts dist/dts/@types/&&npx copyfiles -u 2 src/parser/*.d.ts dist/dts/parser/&&node ./util/resolve-path-alias.js&&rollup -c rollup.config.dts.mjs
scripts.check:parser: npm run pegjs && git diff --exit-code -- src/parser/parser.js src/parser/parser.d.ts && vitest run src/__tests__/parserGeneratedContract.test.ts
scripts.lint: node "$npm_execpath" run check:workflows && biome check src .babelrc.js biome.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.build-dts.json tsconfig.eslint.json vitest.config.ts rollup.config.mjs rollup.config.dts.mjs util/check-workflows.mjs util/generate-parser.js util/package-smoke.mjs util/resolve-path-alias.js && node "$npm_execpath" run check-types && node "$npm_execpath" run check:parser && node "$npm_execpath" run build && node "$npm_execpath" run smoke:package
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write --unsafe src .babelrc.js biome.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.build-dts.json tsconfig.eslint.json vitest.config.ts rollup.config.mjs rollup.config.dts.mjs util/check-workflows.mjs util/generate-parser.js util/package-smoke.mjs util/resolve-path-alias.js
